controls.title: Threat models
blockers: The structured cross-system threat model is enforced in CI, but independent design review and retained review evidence are not complete.

controls.title: Continuous fuzzing
blockers: Continuous fuzz targets, corpus retention, crash triage, and regression promotion are not established across exposed parsers and ABIs.

controls.title: Platform hardening
blockers: W^X and several measured boundaries exist, but complete ASLR, stack protection, SMEP, SMAP, and IOMMU enforcement evidence is incomplete.

controls.title: Privilege separation
blockers: Typed process and transaction boundaries exist, but complete role minimization and secret-lifetime evidence is missing.

controls.title: Application and worker sandboxing
blockers: Corinth worker and recipe boundaries are explicit, but production application sandboxing and escape testing remain incomplete.

controls.title: Offline keys, rotation, and revocation
blockers: Offline release-key custody and completed rotation and revocation drills are not recorded.

controls.title: SBOMs and attestations
blockers: A deterministic source SBOM generator exists, but complete artifact SBOMs and release attestations are not yet independently reproduced.

controls.title: Independent reproducible builds
blockers: Several boot and image artifacts are deterministic, but independent full-distribution replication is not complete.

controls.title: Vulnerability intake and patch SLA
blockers: Intake, severity triage, embargo handling, patch deadlines, rollout, advisory, and rollback drills are not operationally qualified.
